correctness.rationale: The proof converts the exact projection norm to a full-plane Fourier l1 sum, obtains the complete-parabola Gauss baseline, computes exact linear and quadratic perturbation moments by orthogonality, proves cubic-moment cancellation using solution-count bounds, and applies a uniform fourth-order Taylor remainder for q>=16 h^2. The exact b=0 deletion profile is retained. The characteristic-dependent pair specialization uses a finite cosine identity. A standalone 48-case checker verified the critical moments, including F_9; finite tests are not the universal proof.
